title: Valid GitHub Actions context for protected Production promotion evidence

phases.objective: Allow GitHub to register and plan the Production-target generated-artifact evidence workflow by removing the unavailable jobs-level runner.temp expression while preserving exact-head, read-only, and canonical-evidence boundaries.

e2e_journeys.actor: release operator and GitHub Actions workflow planner
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A same-repository pull request is opened, synchronized, or reopened with base Production
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: GitHub schedules Protected Promotion Generated Artifact Refresh on the exact PR head, writes its canonical report to one repository-relative path, uploads the same report, and enforces the structured decision without repository mutation.
steps: Reject jobs-level use of runner.temp before a runner exists.
Bind exact source head, source branch, and Production base identity from the pull-request event.
Checkout the exact same-repository head without persisted credentials.
Run the generated-artifact evaluator from repository root.
Write JSON and Markdown reports under .ci-evidence/production-promotion-generated-artifact-evidence.
Upload the exact report paths and enforce mad4b.pr-generated-artifact-refresh-summary.v1.
assertions: REPORT_PATH and REPORT_MARKDOWN_PATH are stable repository-relative paths.
The evaluator runs from repository root so writer and uploader resolve identical paths.
The workflow remains pull_request-only for base Production and rejects a Production head.
Permissions remain contents:read with persist-credentials:false and no contents:write.
Exact local and remote source-head identity remains enforced.
Job logs remain diagnostic-only and secrets_included remains false.
No migration, deployment, Production mutation, provider call, credential access, external publication, direct contents write, or force push occurs.

phases.objective: Observe one exact-head Production-target pull request schedule the workflow and publish a passed canonical generated-artifact evidence report.
Exercise stale heads, cross-repository heads, invalid base identity, missing reports, blocked generated drift, and publisher failure without consulting Job logs.
This repository automation repair performs no live provider or deployment canary.
The workflow grants no migration, runtime, provider, credential, deployment, or direct Production mutation authority.
